title: •Obi-Wan Kenobi
caption: •Obi-Wan Kenobi (V)
game_text: Obi-Wan’s game text may not be canceled and he may not be targeted by cards that capture. Unless another Jedi present, may Force drain here regardless of Objective restrictions. Immune to attrition < 5 (< 8 if with a Dark Jedi).
lore: Jedi Knight. Trained by Yoda. Friend of Bail Organa. General Kenobi became a hero of the Old Republic during the Clone Wars. Mentor of Anakin and Luke Skywalker.
copyright: TM & © 1995 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1995 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Stats POWER 5 / ABILITY 6 / JEDI KNIGHT (label only); deploy 5 / forfeit 9. Icon column: warrior. Curly apostrophe in Obi-Wan’s. Slip text matches the stub. Rebel. The wiki's default 'Obi-Wan Kenobi' page is the Glossary 2.0 errata version; printed face = 'Obi-Wan Kenobi (Original)' (set Premiere Limited). The only square-on scan is the 745 px Premiere-L-obiwankenobi.gif, tagged D-E1 (errata face; game text differs) — used for art.src (art only); the printed face exists only as the 367×506 decipher-archive photo (downloaded to src/vs8/14-Premiere-L-obiwankenobi-decipher-archive.gif, not used as art). Lore matches both. Copyright: Premiere 1995 per the set (not read off a scan). Modern: V1-L-obiwankenobi.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 1 remake); VB1 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
